# Prompt Guard + jev classifier runtime — fully-resolved, hash-pinned lock for the
# dedicated model-abuse-guard and jev virtualenvs (CPython 3.11+). Do not edit by hand.
#
# server/lib/pythonSetup.js `installLockedRuntime` installs this with
# `--require-hashes --no-deps --only-binary :all:`, so every transitive package is version- and
# hash-pinned and a tampered or substituted distribution fails the install.
# There is no install-time resolution: a missing lock entry for the host is
# reported as an unsupported platform before anything is installed.
# Universal across CPython 3.11+, restricted to arm64 macOS, x86_64/aarch64
# Linux and AMD64 Windows PyPI wheels (torch publishes no Intel-macOS wheels
# for this release). Linux resolves PyPI's default CUDA 13 torch build.
#
# Regenerate after editing requirements-guard-runtime.txt, from the repo root,
# with uv 0.13.7 and a cooldown so brand-new releases are not adopted the day
# they publish:
#   LOCK="$PWD/scripts/requirements-guard-runtime.lock.txt"; TMP="$(mktemp -d)"
#   cp scripts/requirements-guard-runtime{,.lock}.txt "$TMP/"
#   printf '[project]\nname = "guard-lock"\nversion = "0"\n[tool.uv]\nenvironments = ["sys_platform == '"'"'darwin'"'"' and platform_machine == '"'"'arm64'"'"'", "sys_platform == '"'"'linux'"'"' and platform_machine == '"'"'x86_64'"'"'", "sys_platform == '"'"'linux'"'"' and platform_machine == '"'"'aarch64'"'"'", "sys_platform == '"'"'win32'"'"' and platform_machine == '"'"'AMD64'"'"'"]\n' > "$TMP/pyproject.toml"
#   (cd "$TMP" && uv pip compile requirements-guard-runtime.txt --universal --python-version 3.11 \
#     --generate-hashes --only-binary :all: --index-url https://pypi.org/simple --no-header --annotation-style line \
#     --exclude-newer <UTC date at least 7 days ago> -o "$LOCK")
# then check the result against OSV (including MAL- malicious-package records).
# exclude-newer 2026-11-04T00:00:00Z
